lines.t: I’ve been running on empty
With a heart that’s heavy
Every night feels like falling rain
But I still reach out through the pain (YahuShua)
If I’m drifting, pull me close
If pride steps in, let me know
There’s a light that never leaves
Even when I cannot see
(YahuShua)
You’re my strength when I’m weak
You lift me up when I can’t speak
When the world starts pulling me down
You turn my doubt all around
You’re my peace in the storm
(YahuShua, YahuShua)
When I’m lost, You pull me through
I find my way when I lean on You
Every shadow, every fall
You’re there through it all
(YahuShua)
I’ve walked through the fire and the rain
Carried the weight, felt the pain
But every tear that I have cried
Led me back to Your side
(YahuShua)
You’re my strength when I’m weak
You lift me up when I can’t speak
When the world starts pulling me down
You turn my doubt all around
You’re my peace in the storm
(YahuShua, YahuShua)
When my breath runs thin
You’re the hope that lives within
Every night and every day
You’re the reason I can say
When my breath runs thin
You’re the hope that lives within
Every night and every day
You’re the reason I can say
You’re my strength when I’m weak
You lift me up when I can’t speak
When the world starts pulling me down
You turn my doubt all around
You’re my peace in the storm
(YahuShua, YahuShua)
When I’m lost, You pull me through
I find my way when I lean on You
(YahuShua)
